oA_OGC-Security.label: oA OGC-Security
oA_OGC-Security.description: The 'OGC Security' provides the appropriate keying material for a specific OGC Application group in the context of OGC. The keying material will be provided by a key distribution server, and must not be readable by any instance outside the local node.

Documentary_Description.label: Documentary Description
Documentary_Description.description: Resource to hold a documentary text description of the object.

OGC_Security_ID.label: OGC Security ID
OGC_Security_ID.description: Uniquely identifies the OpenAIS Security group that this instance is using.

Accepted_Senders.label: Accepted Senders
Accepted_Senders.description: Stores the identities (OSCORE / IPv6) and Keys of accepted senders in the group

Secret_Group_Key.label: Secret Group Key
Secret_Group_Key.description: Stores the shared symmetric key for low latency group communication.This Resource MUST NOT be readable by any server.
